basis.units: use exact native carrier values; do not infer a global cm-vs-m reconciliation from historical suffixes

frozen_common.repeatability_rule: fresh-process deterministic reruns must be exactly equal in serialized numeric evidence before a positive scientific disposition is admitted

H1.hypothesis: same fixed-plane H_c does not uniquely determine the next whole-window real-SWAP E_c when accepted internal states differ
H1.pair_selection: first response-blind sequentially admissible symmetric forcing pair from frozen characterization order
H1.support_rule: both origins and probes valid, mass-complete and repeatable, endpoint states differ, and abs(E_A-E_B) > 1e-18 native exchange
H1.otherwise: if valid repeatable difference is <= threshold, H1 is not supported at this preregistered resolution; do not tune threshold

H2.hypothesis: same H_c and approximately same total profile water can yield different response when vertical water distribution differs
H2.endpoint_time_rule: compare only trajectories with the same total antecedent duration

candidate_group.enumeration: all ordered length-2 trajectories in alphabet product order; fixed H_star in every interval; failed trajectories retained and excluded from pair matching

H2.pair_enumeration: lexicographic (i,j), i<j, over accepted endpoint trajectories in frozen trajectory order
H2.selection_rule: select first pair satisfying both endpoint criteria without inspecting probe E_c
H2.no_match_rule: if no accepted pair satisfies the frozen criteria, disposition NO_MATCH and do not relax thresholds
H2.support_rule: for a prospectively selected match, abs(E_i-E_j) > 1e-18 native exchange with valid mass-complete repeatable probes

H3.hypothesis: the local interface response derivative depends on committed internal state and coupling window
H3.immutable_origin_method: fresh-process deterministic replay of the full antecedent trajectory before every plus or minus probe; no hidden candidate/state reuse
H3.state_dependence_rule: at a fixed duration, abs(dE_dH_originA-dE_dH_originB) > 1e-12 native exchange per m
H3.window_dependence_rule: for a fixed origin, abs(dE_dH_short-dE_dH_long) > 1e-12 native exchange per m
H3.disposition: report state and window components separately; call full H3 supported only if both components have at least one valid above-threshold comparison

H4.hypothesis: accepted whole-window bottom exchange is a ledger quantity semantically distinct from terminal flux and predictor/tangent coefficients
required_observables: baseline F-GC44 predictor u and affine hcof/rhs with baseline-origin provenance
H4.rule: retain provenance and units separately; do not infer a production sign defect from slope-sign differences; do not treat baseline predictor coefficients as antecedent-origin physical tangents

anti_bias: no scientific pair is selected using probe E_c
failed antecedent and probe trials are retained as evidence
each H3 +/- probe begins from a deterministic fresh replay of the same committed origin
read-only probes must leave committed revision, time and observables unchanged
convergence is necessary but not equivalent to physical correctness
nonclaims: no second MODFLOW hydraulic state variable
no global state sufficiency result outside the frozen B110 carrier and experiment windows
